goal: Make the Property-source coverage manifest express the current difference between repository-derived and production catalogs without hiding either kind of drift.
prohibited_actions: Do not change api.source_capture_inventory_exact(text) or api.source_capture_inventory.
Do not create, alter, apply, preview, or deploy any database object.
Do not remove the truthful samples absent_from_repo_migrations declaration.
Do not weaken unclassified-family, empty-family, stale-declaration, or exposed-family refusals.
assumptions: Current main creates plm.product_type_factory_time in migration 20260911214438, while the recorded production acceptance catalog does not contain it.
The plm.sample_* family predates this repository's migration history and remains present in the live catalog.
This work preserves the now-passing API behavior and changes repository validation only.
stop_conditions: Stop if repository-derived migrations do not contain plm.product_type_factory_time.
Stop if production already contains product_type_factory_time, because the production-absence declaration would be stale.
Stop if the repair requires any database or API change.
Stop if governed exact-head review returns REVISE.
